cases.name: Placement
cases.rationale: Slices 1 and 2 already pin printing, absolute column movement, deferred wrap, and putglyph-equivalent placement more strongly through public cells.

cases.name: Resize
cases.rationale: Phase B adopts growth with cursor attachment through the neutral resize fixture seam.

cases.name: Resize without reset
cases.rationale: Phase B keeps existing content and cursor attachment across consecutive effective resizes.

cases.name: Resize shrink moves cursor
cases.rationale: DanTerm always reflows primary content, so phase B asserts the declared cell or padding anchor instead of libvterm's state-layer column clamp.

cases.name: Resize grow doesn't cancel phantom
cases.rationale: Phase B preserves the pending boundary anchor and places the next print at its reflowed location.

cases.name: Spillover text marks continuation on second line
cases.rationale: flow-soft-wrap.json translates libvterm's continuation-row mark to DanTerm's continues-into-next-row flag.

cases.name: CRLF in column 80 does not mark continuation
cases.rationale: flow-hard-boundary.json reduces the dimensions while retaining the exact right-margin CRLF behavior.

cases.name: EL cancels continuation of following line
cases.rationale: flow-soft-wrap.json uses CUP because reverse index is not implemented, then asserts the equivalent hard-boundary projection.

cases.name: Resize wider preserves cells
cases.rationale: Phase B asserts scalar-exact cells and logical text after growth.

cases.name: Resize wider allows print in new area
cases.rationale: Phase B verifies post-growth cursor placement and printing in the expanded grid.

cases.name: Resize shorter with blanks just truncates
cases.rationale: Phase B trims filler rows strictly below the cursor before any top-row displacement.

cases.name: Resize shorter with content must scroll
cases.rationale: Phase B translates callback order into exact oldest-first scrollback rows, including four blank hard lines.

cases.name: Resize shorter does not lose line with cursor
cases.rationale: Phase B retains the cursor row and displaces only rows required by the smaller viewport.

cases.name: Resize shorter does not send the cursor to a negative row
cases.rationale: DanTerm's declared D2 behavior clamps a displaced cursor to the top viewport row while preserving column and pending wrap.

cases.name: Resize taller attempts to pop scrollback
cases.rationale: Phase B pins no pull when the cursor is above the bottom and adds a native bottom-cursor case that does pull eligible history.

cases.name: Resize can operate on altscreen
cases.rationale: No alternate screen exists in Milestone 2; alternate-screen resize is deferred to Milestone 6.

cases.name: Spillover text marks continuation on second line
cases.rationale: scrollback-pushline.json reduces dimensions and observes DanTerm's preceding-row wrap flag through public history.

cases.name: Continuation mark sent to sb_pushline
cases.rationale: scrollback-pushline.json replaces callback timing with exact retained cells and soft-wrap identity at each scroll-off boundary.

cases.name: Resize wider reflows wide lines
cases.rationale: Phase B adopts the wider reflow outcome and cursor attachment through public rows.

cases.name: Resize narrower can create continuation lines
cases.rationale: Phase B adopts narrower reflow with DanTerm's mechanically translated wrap flag.

cases.name: Shell wrapped prompt behaviour
cases.rationale: Phase B adopts the early widths and expects one-stream history reflow to pull the first prompt back at the final width.

cases.name: Cursor goes missing
cases.rationale: Sub-minimum requests become bit-identical no-ops under D6, while native two-column fixtures preserve the crash-regression intent.
